title: Datives in theological prose
subtitle: Read relation, means, sphere, and reference in context.
overview: A dative may name recipient, means, sphere, reference, or association. A label is useful only when it helps explain the clause’s relationship.
For each dative, write a relational question: to whom, by what, in what sphere, or with reference to what?

sections.title: Dative questions
rows: by grace / in relation to grace
to God: recipient or object of response

items.grc: τῇ γὰρ χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι διὰ πίστεως.
items.en: For by grace you have been saved through faith.
I have been crucified with Christ.
